title: Release authentication preflight
message: clink: Trusted publishing unavailable: configure NUGET_USER and an exact publisher policy. Fallback verification HTTP 403. This probe may require PackageVerify scope; unsupported verification is not evidence of push rejection. Renew NUGET_API_KEY with push permission and the correct package owner/glob, or configure NuGet trusted publishing and set the NUGET_USER repository variable.
